in_arabic.name: سيد
in_arabic.meaning: سيد يعني الشخص الذي يملك السلطة أو النفوذ
in_arabic.long_meaning: سيد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي يملك السلطة أو النفوذ، و هو من الأسماء التي تدل على الرفعة و العلو، و قد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالِمِينَ'، و هو اسم ذو شرف و رفعة في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: سید
in_urdu.meaning: سید کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی قبیلے یا خاندان کا سربراہ ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: سید ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی قبیلے یا خاندان کا سربراہ ہوتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں بہت اہم ہے کیونکہ سیدنا رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے سید و آقا ہونے کی وجہ سے، یہ نام مذہبی اور ثقافتی لحاظ سے اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: सैय्यद
in_hindi.meaning: सैय्यद का अर्थ है किसी परिवार या वंश का मुखिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: सैय्यद एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है किसी परिवार या वंश का मुखिया, यह नाम इस्लाम में बहुत सम्मानित है क्योंकि यह नाम पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम के वंशजों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण हैं

in_pashto.name: سيد
in_pashto.meaning: سيد د يوې قوم يا خاندان مشر ته ويل کيږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: سيد يو عربي نوم دی چې د يوې قوم يا خاندان مشر ته ويل کيږي، دا نوم په اسلام کې ډير اهم دی ځکه چې د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم د سيد او آقا په وجه، دا نوم ديني او کلتوري لحاظه مهم ګڼل کيږي

in_english.name: Sayyed
in_english.meaning: Sayyed means a leader or a chief of a tribe or family
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sayyed originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'sayyid' which means a leader or a chief of a tribe or family. In Islamic tradition, Sayyed is a title given to descendants of the Prophet Muhammad. The name holds significant spiritual and cultural importance across Muslim communities worldwide, symbolizing nobility, leadership, and prophetic lineage.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the title "Sayyed" is often given as a title of respect and honor to individuals recognized as descendants of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) through his lineage, known as the Ahl al-Bayt or the People of the House. These individuals have a unique status and role in Islamic history and society as they are considered as the spiritual and temporal leaders of the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the title "Sayyed" conveys the idea of being a spiritual guide or leader. This is reflected in the Prophetic tradition that says, "The best of my Ummah (nation) are my Ahl al-Bayt (People of the House)." Due to their close genealogical connection to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), Sayyeds are believed to have a unique spiritual connection and insight, and are often consulted for guidance and wisdom. This title is not only restricted to the descendants of the Prophet, but it is also used for prominent spiritual figures and scholars who have shown exceptional spiritual guidance and leading within the Muslim community.

historical_references.reference: Sayyed Ahmad Shahid, a prominent figure in the Indian subcontinent's 19th-century uprising against the British, was known as Sayyed due to his descent from the Prophet Muhammad through his ancestor Imam Hassan.
historical_references.context: Indian Rebellion against the British East India Company

historical_references.reference: Sayyid Qutb, a key ideologue of the Muslim Brotherhood and the chief inspirer of modern Islamic fundamentalism, was born into an Egyptian noble family and was given the title Sayyid due to his lineage from the Prophet Muhammad.
historical_references.context: Egyptian Islamic revival and the Muslim Brotherhood
